mapper.sql: id, elder_id, plan_id, take_date, remind_time, take_time, status, note, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_log (elder_id, plan_id, take_date, remind_time, take_time, status, note) VALUES (#{elderId}, #{planId}, #{takeDate}, #{remindTime}, #{takeTime}, #{status}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medication_log WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY take_date DESC, remind_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM medication_log WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} AND take_date = #{takeDate} ORDER BY remind_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM medication_log WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} AND take_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY take_date DESC, remind_time ASC, id ASC
